MV stands for Monetization Value, which is calculated as the total spending multiplied by a factor that accounts for membership duration.

args.sql:
WITH fan_engagement_index AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.userregistry, 
        t1.nicklabel, 
        t1.tierstep, 
        t3.engrate, 
        t3.socintscore, 
        t3.actdayswk, 
        t3.avgsesscount, 
        t2.spendusd, 
        t2.membdays, 
        ((t3.engrate + t3.socintscore + t3.actdayswk + t3.avgsesscount) / 4) AS fei, 
        (spendusd * (membdays / 365.0)) AS mv 
    FROM 
        fans AS t1 
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending AS t2 ON t1.userregistry = t2.memberfanpivot 
    JOIN 
        engagement AS t3 ON t2.memberreg = t3.engagememberpivot 
    WHERE 
        t1.statustag = 'Active'
), 
superfans AS (
    SELECT 
        userregistry, 
        nicklabel, 
        tierstep, 
        engrate, 
        socintscore, 
        actdayswk, 
        avgsesscount, 
        spendusd, 
        membdays, 
        fei, 
        mv, 
        CASE 
            WHEN tierstep >= 8 AND fei > 0.7 AND mv > 200 THEN 'Superfan' 
            ELSE 'Regular Fan' 
        END AS fan_category 
    FROM 
        fan_engagement_index 
)
SELECT 
    nicklabel, 
    tierstep, 
    fei AS engagement_score, 
    mv AS financial_contribution, 
    fan_category 
FROM 
    superfans 
ORDER BY 
    engagement_score DESC, 
    financial_contribution DESC;

        nicklabel, 
        tierstep, 
        engrate, 
        socintscore, 
        actdayswk, 
        avgsesscount, 
        spendusd, 
        membdays, 
        fei, 
        mv, 
        CASE 
            WHEN tierstep >= 8 AND fei > 0.7 AND mv > 200 THEN 'Superfan' 
            ELSE 'Regular Fan' 
        END AS fan_category 
    FROM 
        fan_engagement_index 
)
SELECT 
    nicklabel, 
    tierstep, 
    fei AS engagement_score, 
    mv AS financial_contribution, 
    fan_category 
FROM 
    superfans 
ORDER BY 
    engagement_score DESC, 
    financial_contribution DESC;
